Mages Guild: Arch-Mage's Robe

Arch-Mage Trebonius has sent me on a mission to retrieve the stolen Arch-Mage's robe. He doesn't know who took them, or what the robes look like; but he claims they are still in the Imperial City... maybe I should talk to other guild members about where the Arch-Mage's robe might be.

Shipments for the Mages Guild from the Imperial City are processed in Ebonheart by the East Empire Trading Company. I was pointed towards Canctunian Ponius as my next contact regarding the Arch-Mage’s robe.

Canctunian Ponius informed me that the package containing the Arch-Mage’s robe was lost on the road between Septim Gate Pass and Karthor Dale. He would not divulge very much information on the nature of what "accosted" the trade caravan and refused my offer to assist in the official investigation. I should report my findings back to Trebonius.

Trebonius does not want to wait for the East Empire Company to complete their investigation. He is sending me directly to the heart of the crime. I don’t know how he knows where it is... he instructed me to speak with Flacassia Fauseius, the guild guide in Vivec. He gave her the teleportation scroll and instructions on how to use it properly.
Flacassia Fauseius informed me that Trebonius’ teleportation scroll may not take me to a determinate location.
Flacassia Fauseius informed me that, before his death, Trebonius gave her a scroll which he believed would transport the target to a location where the Arch-Mage's robe is located.

I have been teleported to a large cavern. Canctunian Ponius said that the caravan was robbed on the road... what am I doing below the ground? Maybe the scroll Trebonius made was defective. I should look for a way out of this cave system.
I have encountered a strange little Orc named Gorluck. He is looking for a book he lost. I don’t really have time to help him but perhaps he can help me if I find his lost book.
Gorluck cleared a passage to another part of this cavern system and has offered to travel with me. I should continue on to find the Arch-Mage's robe.
We have found someone wearing the Arch-Mage's robes. I need to get the robe back from them...

The thief of the Arch-Mage's robe was a High Elf woman named Lillorne of Wey. She claimed to have desired an Arch-Mage's robe ever since Ocato set her the task of enchanting them. She must have stolen it while it was being delivered to Trebonius. She is now dead.
I gave the Arch-Mage's robe to Trebonius.
Yes, we're both members of the Mages Guild. I'm sure your colleagues think you look very nice but I don't have a robe befitting my rank. Why? Because someone stole the Arch-Mage's robe!
You have already received your Master Robes. I cannot give you another. Sorry, %PCName.
%PCRank, did you never recieve your Master Robes? Please allow me to correct that error and give them to you to symbolize your advancement in the guild!
%PCRank, did you never recieve your Master Robes? Please allow me to correct that error and give them to you to symbolize your advancement in the guild.
Congratulations on achieving the rank of Wizard, %PCName. Please accept your Master Robes to symbolize your advancement in the guild. Wear it proudly.
You have already received your Novice Robes. I cannot give you another. Sorry, %PCName.

You still have not been given your novice robes? Well, perhaps it is more of a formality now, but as a member of the Mages Guild, you will receive a novice robe. Take good care of it, for you cannot acquire another. If you have not already done so, any member of rank Journeyman or above may visit Falaine Safronia who is the guild provisioner located at the Caldera Guildhall. She can sell you robes focused on each school of magic if you meet certain requirements which she will explain.

Ah yes, thank you for reminding me. As a member of the Mages Guild, you will receive your first mage robe. Take good care of it, for you cannot acquire another. However, once you are at least a Journeyman, you may visit Falaine Safronia who is the guild provisioner here at the Caldera Guildhall. She can sell you robes focused on each school of magic if you meet certain requirements which she will explain.

You've already been given Novice Robes of Restoration to enhance your abilities. Continue to serve the guild, %PCRank.

Do you seek to advance your own training in Restoration, %PCRank? In recognition of your handling of the unsanctioned training, I will provide you with your own Novice Robes of Restoration. Do not misuse your abilities as others do.

The guild must sanction magical training; for the safety of all citizens of the empire of course. Restoration in particular is a critical area due to its ties to healing which naturally require specialized training which the guild provides.
You've been expelled, %PCRank. I can't trust you with this critical mission until you are accepted back into the ranks.
I already gave you my... the Arch-Mage's robe.
Then let us commence the procedure. Be prepared for anything, %PCRank.
Come back when you are prepared.
Are you ready to use Trebonius' scroll of teleportation?
Glad to see you made it back safely, %PCRank.

Before his... retirement, Trebonius gave me a scroll which he believed would transport the target to a location where the Arch-Mage's robe is located. His instructions were exact... if somewhat confusing: the posipoint in his calculations seems to be a floating variable. Would you like to travel there now, Arch-Mage?

Yes, Trebonius did give me a scroll. His instructions were exact... if somewhat confusing: the posipoint in his calculations seems to be a floating variable. Which, if I understand correctly, should be the place where the Arch-Mage's robes were stolen. How can that change? But in any event, are you ready?
You're the Arch-Mage now... shouldn't Trebonius have given you back the robes?
Ah. Yes... now that you are the Arch-Mage, I suppose that you will be wanting your robe.
I assume you haven't lost the Arch-Mage's robe already.
I heard that you found the Arch-Mage's robe. Remarkable work, %PCRank!
Thank you for your diligence regarding this matter, %PCRank. Your efforts have not gone unnoticed.
Well done, %PCRank. With these robes, I will finally look the part. Oh, and something for your trouble.
What are you still doing here? You must find my robes!

I anticipated this and have prepared a scroll of teleportation to transport you to the heart of the crime forthwith. Talk to Flacassia Fauseius. I have given her the scroll and explicit instructions on how to use it.

So the East Empire Company is looking for my robe? Those septim-hoarding accountants will take half the year simply to decide which of their fifteen departments should be leading the investigation. I need the Arch-Mage's robes now! No one will listen to me until I have them. It's time for us to take matters into our own hands, %PCRank.
Congratulations, %PCRank. You can now look the part.
Excuse me. But even so, this is beyond your jurisdiction. Now if you'll excuse me.

Civilians -- even those who are members of Imperial institutions -- are not permitted to interfere in official investigations of this nature. Now if you'll excuse me, I have a meeting with the Duke to prepare for.
Our agents are working with the Imperial Legion to recover said items of value by due course.

A special shipment from High Chancellor Ocato for the Guild of Mages in Vivec City? Yes, there was one on the books. Unfortunately, the particular caravan carrying that package was accosted on the road between Septim Gate Pass and Karthor Dale on the mainland. The package from Ocato and many other goods are still missing.
Trebonius seems obsessed with finding those robes and he's not even Arch-Mage anymore! Please let me know if I can be of any assistance, %PCRank.
Trebonius seems obsessed with finding those robes... word has spread like wildfire. And everyone knows you're the one he's assigned to figure out where they are. Best of luck to you, %PCRank.

It is unlikely that the robe never left the Imperial City. I would suggest starting at the East Empire Trading Company in Ebonheart. Shipments from the Imperial City or the Arcane University are typically processed there. Canctunian Ponius is the local Factor.
I take it you haven't recovered your robe yet. More's the pity.
I take it you haven't recovered my robe yet. Be off with you now.
Yes, it was last seen in the Imperial City. That's where you should start. Now be off with you.
Not any longer, %PCRank! I am overwriting all your previous orders: find my stolen robe!

High Chancellor Ocato himself had an exquisitely designed robe delivered to me as a symbol of my high office but it never arrived! Now that you are Arch-Mage, %PCName, this is your problem. You should find your stolen robe.
High Chancellor Ocato himself had an exquisitely designed robe delivered to me as a symbol of my high office but it never arrived! This is your most imperative mission now: find my stolen robe!
Friends help each other, %PCName. You found my book, and I cleared the way to be on your way!

So you are a loser too, friend? Losing your way and losing your robe; loosing tears as I have over my book. I can help you, friend. Look here at this rock, this rock looks like it has the way and your robe is on the way.
Friends help each other, each other. You have helped me, %PCName, now how, how? Can I -- Gorluck the Miner -- help you?
The eight magical disciplines traditionally associated with the Mages Guild are: enchant, destruction, alteration, illusion, conjuration, mysticism, restoration, and alchemy.
I hope you put the Novice Robes of Illusion that I gave you to good use whenever you find yourself in dangerous places, %PCName.

Filled with steam centurions and ancient machinery, Dwemer ruins are dangerous places not suitable for the faint of heart. Since you helped me so much with Chimarvamidium, I'd like to give you these Novice Robes of Illusion. They will help you with many dangerous places and situations.

Soul trapping has been codified as part of the School of Mysticism by the Mages Guild - that is why I gave you the Novice Robes of Mysticism. I trust you will not lose them, %PCName. What the magical community calls "soul trapping" is the mystical capture of a soul's animus which is the spiritual energy of the living being. If it is not captured in this way, that energy will either dissipate to the surroundings or be absorbed by another lodestone if a suitably powerful object is nearby.
Given your handling of the ash ghoul soul, I believe that you show promising skills with Mysticism, %PCRank. Take these Novice Robes of Mysticism. They will enhance your natural abilities.

The guild has always struggled with hedge mages operating outside the authority of Imperial charters. The membership and rank requirements enforce a certain level of discipline to the Mage's Oath while the individual's skill with particular schools is a prerequisite to permit purchase of robes which will be worn to represent their membership and public advocacy of the guild.

The "Guilds Act" requires that members be examined for certain skill and rank requirements before they can be sold novice robes for any of the mage disciplines. But I have already examined you recently; please wait another day before being reexamined.
The "Guilds Act" requires that members be examined for certain skill and rank requirements before they can be sold novice robes for any of the mage disciplines. Do you wish to be examined now?
You will die now!

I know you are here for the robe, mage. But you will not have it! In my heart, I have yearned for an Arch-Mage's robe from the very day Ocato set me the task of enchanting them. I knew that it must be mine, Lillorne of Wey. The power! The prestige! And now here you are, seeking to take what should be mine - my creation! You will die now!
Farewell, my strange friend.

You helped yourself to your robe, and I helped yourself to the way out! My strange friend, I have enjoyed our quest together, but here we must part ways in a way. I must return to my cave with my book but without my friend. However, and for ever, I would like to gift you a gift: this miner's helm -- my spare which I can spare. Don't forget to leave -- you'll find your way out through the unpleasant lady's amulet of amulets.
You must take and take your robe back from this unpleasant person, and I will help you. Help you more than with the batty bats!

There are other ways out of Gorluck's Cave, but this is the only one with a robe. A robe! My strange friend, this robe has a most unpleasant wearer of the mostly unpleasant sort. You must take and take your robe back, and I will help you. Help you more than with the batty bats!
There are dangerous, dangerous bats in this tunnel. They've been driven mad by the ringing rocks. I wouldn't have taken you up here but this is the way. There are other ways, but they are not yours.
Now that you have found my book, my book! You are my strange friend.
I won't move until I find my book... my book! You are welcome to stay and stay longer in my cave, Gorluck's Cave, if you find my book.

A stranger in my cave. My cave? How strange and stranger! There are lots and lots of rocks here in my cave -- but I won't look for any of them until I find my book... my book! You are welcome to stay and stay longer in my cave, Gorluck's Cave, if you find my book.
Welcome Arch-Mage, would you like to purchase any master robes or novice robes?
Welcome Master Wizard, would you like to purchase any master robes or novice robes?

Do you wish to purchase novice robes? This service is only available to Journeymen and those of higher rank in the guild.
I am Gorluck the Miner. This is my cave - The Cave.
I am a miner; miner of precious things and rocks. Lots of rocky rocks.
I am thankful, and thank you, for finding my book.
You found my book? A stranger no longer, you are now my strange friend, %PCName.
Woe and woeful sadness fill my cave and yet why would you taunt me, stranger?
My eyes shed water like the rocks, those rocks under the eaves of the roof. My lost book is lost!
You, stranger, are cruel.
My lost book is lost!
